system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
```yaml
imports:
  - path: path/to/iam_service_account.py
  - path: path/to/iam_workload_identity_pool.py
  - path: path/to/iam_workload_identity_pool_provider.py

resources:
  - name: github-deploy-sa
    type: iam_service_account.py
    properties:
      accountId: github-actions-deploy
      displayName: GitHub Actions Cloud Run Deployer
      description: Service account for GitHub Actions to deploy Cloud Run services via WIF

  - name: github-wif-pool
    type: iam_workload_identity_pool.py
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolId: github-pool
      displayName: GitHub Actions Pool
      description: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions
      disabled: false

  - name: github-wif-provider
    type: iam_workload_identity_pool_provider.py
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolId: $(ref.github-wif-pool.workloadIdentityPoolId)
      workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: github-provider
      displayName: GitHub OIDC Provider
      description: OIDC provider for GitHub Actions
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.repository_owner: assertion.repository_owner
      attributeCondition: "assertion.repository_owner == 'your-org' && assertion.repository == 'your-org/your-repo'"
      oidc:
        issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      disabled: false

  - name: bind-wif-to-sa
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:virtual.projects.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.github-deploy-sa.email)
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
            members:
              - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-deploy-sa.email)
              - principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ env.PROJECT_NUMBER }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/$(ref.github-wif-pool.workloadIdentityPoolId)/subject/repo:your-org/your-repo:ref:refs/heads/main

  - name: grant-cloudrun-permissions
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.setIamPolicy
    properties:
      bindings:
        - role: roles/run.developer
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-deploy-sa.email)
        - role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-deploy-sa.email)
        - role: roles/storage.objectAdmin
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-deploy-sa.email)
        - role: roles/artifactregistry.writer
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-deploy-sa.email)
```
